//: THE BROWSER FILES, TYPE-CHECKED — read only by scripts/browser-types.mjs.
The base tsconfig runs checkJs false, and TypeScript only reads a .js file
when a .ts file imports it, so most of the studio's screens were checked by
nothing at all (measured 05/10/2026: 249 of 421 browser files carried 5,495
errors nobody could see). This config includes every file and turns checkJs
on; the script counts the errors per file against a baseline that may only
go down. A file leaves the baseline when it is converted to .ts/.tsx, where
tsconfig.strict.json grades it with noImplicitAny on.
